paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者先说明一个计划时间不够，之后才补背景；听者当下没有回应。顺序、可用背景和听者真实理解不同，沉默不证明不满，较高均值也不认证造成伤害。清楚拒绝可以仍然合适，不需为降低数字而增加所有解释。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene: A fictional reader first says a plan has insufficient time and adds context later; the listener gives no immediate answer. Sequence, available context and the listener’s actual understanding differ. Silence proves no dislike and a higher mean certifies no harm. A clear refusal may remain appropriate without extra explanations to lower a number.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“虚构叙述里实际说了什么，哪些背景已提供，哪些他人反应仍未知？”可只读或谈虚构人物，不需找证人、征求他人评价或公开个人数字。保留未知和不同理解即可，讨论不以取得喜欢、重建联系或降低均值为目标。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card asks: “What was actually said in the fictional account, what context was supplied, and which reactions remain unknown?” Read alone or discuss fictional people without witnesses, other people’s evaluations or public numbers. Unknowns and different interpretations may remain; liking, resumed contact and lower means are never goals.

paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these additions. Reading alone suffices; existing actions and recall exercises are optional. Consider interactions you can recall now without imposing a four-week or other fixed window. The earlier form’s Chinese items and five endorsement anchors remain, with new working English. Five groups each have four direct items without reversals. Ratings 1–5 describe fit; three retains uncertainty or depending on the situation as numeric information, not sometimes, neutrality or missingness. This source form has no NA or unscored response. All twenty answers must be valid before any personal sum, mean or interpretation. Missingness supplies no zero or midpoint and no answered subset is interpreted. If nothing fits, stop and read all five guides. Each group has a raw sum of 4–20 divided by four for an exact quarter-step mean, displayed to two decimals. Ratings 4, 3, 2, 4 sum to thirteen and give 3.25, without one-decimal approximation. Groups have no total, rank, main cause, flaw or severity. Equal sums establish no equal effects; retake changes certify no improvement. Only self-reports are collected, without peer or partner ratings, observation or event verification. They reveal neither whether others noticed, were affected nor dislike the reader. There are no established reliability, validity, norms, fairness, prediction or English–Chinese equivalence, and no diagnosis, popularity, worth, hiring, relationship selection or safety decision. Fictional discussion needs no actual person’s answer, disclosure, contact, pleasing, overpromising, explanation of refusal or lower boundaries. Anyone may decline. A clear no can be complete; ending unsafe contact requires neither negotiation nor a return promise. Page memory, optional 24-hour tab drafts and completion, exit or retake clearing remain unchanged, without a final personal-result cache. Copying contains only a public title and entry link, without answers, raw sums or means; public pages restore no private attempt.
